title: R API to the rw CLI for webR

title: Output the absolute pathname of the 'rw' command-line tool — find_rw
code: # Get the pathname of the 'rw' tool part of the 'rw' package $ Rscript -e rw::find_rw  # Call the 'rw' tool $ "$(Rscript -e rw::find_rw)" --help  # Define a Bash rw() function that locates the 'rw' tool and calls # it forwarding all command-line arguments as-is $ rw() { "$(Rscript -e rw::find_rw)" "$@"; } $ rw --help  # Define a Bash rw() function, where we locate the 'rw' tool once # so that the rw() does not have to look up the location each time $ eval "rw() { \"$(Rscript -e rw::find_rw)\" \"\$@\"; }" $ rw --help

what: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
text: Executes R code sandboxed WebAssembly environment via rw CLI tool webR.

title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
code: rw(   expr = NULL,   file = NULL,   prologue_expr = NULL,   epilogue_expr = NULL,   prologue = NULL,   epilogue = NULL,   r_libs = NULL,   binds = NULL,   stage = NULL,   shims = NULL,   timeout = 0,   vanilla = FALSE,   debug = FALSE,   args = NULL )

title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
text: expr (character vector) R expressions evaluate. element passed separate --expr argument. file (character string) Path R script file execute. used together expr. prologue_expr, epilogue_expr (character vector) R expressions evaluate /main code. access stage directory specified. prologue, epilogue (character string) Paths R script files source /main code. r_libs (character string) Path R package library host mount webR. recommended path rw_r_libs_user(). binds (named character vector) Host directories mount webR. Names webR mount paths, values host paths. example, c("/host/data" = "/path//data"). stage (character string) Path staging directory host. directory mounted prologue epilogue execution, allowing trusted code pass data /sandboxed main code. shims (character vector) Shims install R. Default "install.packages". Set character(0) disable. timeout (numeric) Maximum execution time seconds. exceeded, interrupt signal sent R. Use 0.0 (default) timeout. vanilla (logical) TRUE, run R --vanilla flag. debug (logical) TRUE, output debug information. args (character vector) Additional arguments pass R script (accessible via commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE) webR).

title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
text: character vector containing captured output (stdout stderr combined) R code execution.

title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
text: security model uses webR's isolation controlled host directory access: Main code: Runs without access stage directory Prologue/Epilogue code: access stage data transfer binds directories: Available phases r_libs: Mounted R package library available phases

title: Run R Code in webR (WebAssembly) — rw
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Evaluate a simple expression rw(expr = "sum(1:100)")  # Run an R script rw(file = "analysis.R")  # With timeout rw(expr = "Sys.sleep(10)", timeout = 3.0)  # Pass data via stage directory stage_dir <- tempdir() saveRDS(list(a = 1, b = 2), file.path(stage_dir, "input.rds")) rw(   prologue_expr = "data <- readRDS('/host/stage/input.rds')",   expr = "result <- lapply(data, sqrt)",   epilogue_expr = "saveRDS(result, '/host/stage/output.rds')",   stage = stage_dir ) result <- readRDS(file.path(stage_dir, "output.rds")) } # }

title: Call an R Function in webR — rw_do_call

code: rw_do_call(   what,   args = list(),   quote = FALSE,   r_libs = NULL,   binds = NULL,   shims = NULL,   timeout = 0,   vanilla = FALSE,   debug = FALSE )

title: Call an R Function in webR — rw_do_call
text: (function) function call. args (list) list arguments pass function. quote (logical) TRUE, arguments args quoted evaluated passed webR. Default FALSE. r_libs (character string) Path R package library host mount webR. recommended path rw_r_libs_user(). binds (named character vector) Host directories mount webR. Names webR mount paths, values host paths. example, c("/host/data" = "/path//data"). shims (character vector) Shims install R. Default "install.packages". Set character(0) disable. timeout (numeric) Maximum execution time seconds. exceeded, interrupt signal sent R. Use 0.0 (default) timeout. vanilla (logical) TRUE, run R --vanilla flag. debug (logical) TRUE, output debug information.

title: Call an R Function in webR — rw_do_call
text: return value function call, evaluated webR.

title: Call an R Function in webR — rw_do_call
